messages.subject: Bracken v Calderwood - Defence served
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah, Elena,

The Defence came in yesterday (attached). As expected they are running the alleged July 2024 oral variation to 380 bar, plus force majeure on the delays and a mitigation argument on the Marlin pricing. They also rely on the clause 12 liability cap.

I think the oral variation is their whole case and clause 19 (no oral modification) is our answer. Suggest we get a Reply drafted and put the variation point to counsel. Elena - could you start pulling the contemporaneous documents on the alleged July meeting?

Tom

Tom Gallagher
Associate
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ

Agreed on all points. Clause 19 plus the absence of any written record of the alleged variation should see off the variation defence (Rock Advertising). Let's get the Reply out early in the new year and book a short advice from Catherine on merits and quantum before the CCMC.
